mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate profit growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt aggressive rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a housing starts level below 1300 thousand units signals weakening residential demand and an impending economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1300 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for the HOUST signal in late-cycle is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a contraction in industrial output, signaling weak economic activity and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales level (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high employment levels (PAYEMS > 159000) signals an overheating labor market that may lead to wage-driven inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 159000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1350 thousand units signals strong residential demand and a positive economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1350, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
